entities.summary: Martin Kampmann is a Danish former professional mixed martial artist who competed in the Ultimate Fighting Championship, where he achieved success as a top 5 contender. Kampmann is often considered one of the best Mixed martial artists to never fight for a UFC championship title. In October 2012, he was ranked the number 1 welterweight in the world. He is a former Cage Warriors World Middleweight Champion.
